query:
SELECT 
  'Todos (active=1, não composto)' as tipo,
  COUNT(*) as qtd,
  ROUND(SUM(currentStock * avgCost), 2) as valor_estoque
FROM products 
WHERE active = 1 
  AND (isComposite = 0 OR isComposite IS NULL)
  AND currentStock > 0
  AND avgCost > 0
  AND companyId = 1

UNION ALL

SELECT 
  'Todos (incluindo inativos, não composto)' as tipo,
  COUNT(*) as qtd,
  ROUND(SUM(currentStock * avgCost), 2) as valor_estoque
FROM products 
WHERE (isComposite = 0 OR isComposite IS NULL)
  AND currentStock > 0
  AND avgCost > 0
  AND companyId = 1

UNION ALL

SELECT 
  'Inativos com estoque' as tipo,
  COUNT(*) as qtd,
  ROUND(SUM(currentStock * avgCost), 2) as valor_estoque
FROM products 
WHERE active = 0
  AND (isComposite = 0 OR isComposite IS NULL)
  AND currentStock > 0
  AND avgCost > 0
  AND companyId = 1
